scientific_limitations_and_integrity.known_input: The cube covariogram and its radial mean integral, as well as the axial and full-diagonal evaluations, are established in Proposition 34 of arXiv:2601.20117v2.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: No claim for other parameters, other dimensions, or uniqueness in the historical literature; no independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.new_contribution: Exact global angular minimization and maximization, with all oblique 24 inball contacts and all six axial outer contacts.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof: A closed covariogram integration followed by exact two-variable interior stationary-point and four-edge comparisons, and classical uniqueness of extremal ellipsoids.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: The Gardner–Zhang first radial mean body of the centered unit-halfside Euclidean three-cube only; exact global Euclidean John and Löwner contact sets.

title: Exact John and Löwner contact orbits of the first radial mean body of a three-cube
